cubism.customize.title: Customize Cubism
cubism.customize.compass.tooltip: Show UP, WEST and NORTH on the cube
cubism.customize.search.tooltip: Try random seeds until one has everything that is checked. Stop keeps the closest seed. The percent beside a checked item is how many seeds had it
cubism.customize.settings.title: Cube Settings
cubism.customize.climate.reset: Click to set Temperature and Humidity back to Normal
cubism.customize.pregen.columns: About %s chunk columns before you join
cubism.customize.finite_loot.tooltip: Adds trades, gifts and drops for the items that a small cube may not generate: armor trims, pottery sherds, some music discs, sponge, echo shards and more. Vanilla loot stays the same.
cubism.customize.presets.title: Cubism Presets
cubism.customize.preset.every_climate.de: Desert, jungle, snow, savanna and taiga
cubism.customize.preset.desert_planet.de: A hot and dry climate. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubism.customize.preset.frozen_planet.de: A very cold climate with snowy plains, snowy taiga, ice spikes and frozen peaks. Sets Temperature
cubism.customize.preset.jungle_planet.de: A warm and wet climate with every jungle. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubism.customize.preset.swamp_planet.des: A very wet climate with swamp and mangrove swamp. Sets Humidity
A very hot and dry climate with all three badlands. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubism.customize.preset.savanna_planet.d: A warm and dry climate with savanna, savanna plateau and windswept savanna. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubism.customize.preset.mountains.descri: Jagged peaks, stony peaks, snowy slopes, windswept hills and grove
cubism.customize.preset.ocean_world.desc: Warm, lukewarm, cold, frozen and deep ocean
cubism.customize.preset.wonderland.descr: Cherry grove, flower forest, sunflower plains and meadow
cubism.customize.preset.haunted_woods.de: Dark forest, pale garden and swamp
cubism.customize.preset.giant_trees.desc: Old growth pine, spruce and birch, and bamboo jungle
cubism.customize.preset.temple_tour.desc: Desert pyramid, jungle temple, igloo and swamp hut
Buried treasure, shipwreck, ocean ruins, trail ruins and ruined portal
cubism.customize.preset.caves.descriptio: Lush caves, dripstone caves, deep dark and sulfur caves
cubism.customize.preset.structure_hunter: Village, outpost, mansion, monument and ancient city
options.cubism.edgeCameraTilt.tooltip: When on, the camera turns with the ground over a rounded cube edge. Turn it off if the tilt makes you feel sick. When off, the camera stays level with the face and turns quickly when you cross onto the next face. Flight still tilts.
